svg.text: CONCEPT STUDY - PROVISIONAL DIMENSIONS - DO NOT BUILD WITHOUT REVIEW
1. Zones and labels taken from web/src/main.js; widths and grids from web/src/style.css.
2. CSS breakpoints: 1250 px, 930 px, 620 px (panels stack, sidebar hides on mobile).
3. Demo data in web/src/demo-trips.json: real route and weather, simulated vehicles and events.
4. Rule: the platform never shows an alert it has not received. Stored alerts are shown as stored.
Redline control center (web/), desktop view at 1440 px
Simulation: route and weather are real open data, the rest is simulated
LIVE MAP . POSITION, CORRIDOR AND RELAYS
LINKS . MODES . ARRIVAL ESTIMATE OR LAST GASP
Logo, shipment cards with live status, view links
Promise, and what is real versus simulated
Arrival, device mode, last contact, speed or relays
Corridor, plan, track, alerts, fleet relays
What the platform received, and what is still stored on the device
Scrub or play the whole trip
Filters what is known at time t
Link and mode strips, plan versus live ETA, last gasp
Stopped 10 min outside every authorized zone
b title and time of the event on the device
d severity, channel, delay before delivery
1. Pick a shipment (1), read its status chip and KPIs (4, 5).
2. Follow the alerts (7); each shows the channel it travelled and how late it arrived.
3. Click an alert to centre the map on it (6).
4. Replay (8) to see only what the platform knew at that moment.
5. Check the arrival estimate or the last gasp (9). Export the log (2).
